result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but there are two notable problems: an inconsistent/low-contrast favorite button on the second 'Popular right now' card, and a category filter state that does not appear to affect the listed results.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card (the pizza card) uses a dark, nearly black circular background with a white outline heart, while the identical control on the ramen card above uses a white circle with a dark heart. The dark variant blends into the dark food image and is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Use the same white/translucent circular background and consistent heart icon color for all favorite buttons, ensuring sufficient contrast over any image.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as active (selected black state), yet the listings below include poké, burgers, pasta and ramen restaurants that are not pizza, so the filter appears to have no effect on results.
issues.suggestion: Apply the selected category filter to the listed sections, or deselect the chip / show 'All' as active when no filtering is applied.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative translucent circles are clipped abruptly at the banner's right/bottom edge, and the banner's rounded corner on the right side is not visually matched by the circle overlay, making the shape look slightly unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Clip decorative shapes to the banner's rounded rectangle mask so they follow the corner radius cleanly.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell, favorite hearts, search icon) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are missing, screen reader users cannot identify them.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications', 'Add to favorites') to all icon-only buttons.
